html:
King of Shewa and, from 1889 to 1913, emperor of Ethiopia. He kept the Ethiopian Empire independent when almost all of Africa fell to European rule.

  • He expanded the empire south, east and west, taking Harar in 1887 and many Oromo and other lands, which gave Ethiopia roughly its modern borders.
  • With his wife, Empress Taytu, he founded Addis Ababa in 1886.
  • The Treaty of Wuchale of 1889 with Italy had a clause that Italy read as making Ethiopia a protectorate. Menelik rejected it.
  • He bought modern rifles and in 1896 crushed the Italian army at the Battle of Adwa.

After Adwa he brought in a railway to Djibouti, telegraphs, a bank and modern schools. Strokes left him unable to rule from 1909, and he died in 1913. Haile Selassie, son of his cousin Ras Makonnen, later carried on his work of modernising.
